subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 It is a bad habit to put off the lesson for tomorrow. Good students never do this. It is negligence of one's duty. If you are not (a) ----- (dutiful) -----, you will never do it. If you are undutiful, you will do it. Undutifulness is a very bad practice that brings about (b) ----- (adverse) ----- in life. To become successful in life, you must be dutiful. It is also a kind of (c) ----- (deceive) ----- that one does not prepare the lessons daily. It is also a part of (d) ----- (lazy) ----- because the lazy students are found irregular in preparing their lessons and other topics in (e) ----- (accord) ----- with their routine.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) undutiful; (b) adversity; (c) self-deception; (d) laziness; (e) accordance.
